visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young boy wearing a striped polo shirt and white shorts is seen running through a park on bright green artificial turf. He loses his balance and falls forward onto his hands and knees. He stays on the ground, burying his face in his hands while sobbing. The setting includes a white metal fence and lush green trees in the background under bright daylight. (2) Another young boy with glasses, wearing a beige shirt and tan shorts, approaches the crying boy. He kneels down beside him with a comforting expression and offers a white tissue. Urban apartment buildings and green trees are visible in the background as they interact. (3) Transitioning to an indoor setting, the boy with glasses is now sitting on a beige sofa. He presents a dark grey and black backpack. He uses his hands to demonstrate modular components, such as a detachable tissue pouch and a coin purse, while smiling at the camera. (4) A close-up shot captures clear water being poured over the surface of the backpack. The water beads up and rolls off, highlighting the material's water resistance. He then opens the main compartment to show it packed with numerous books, demonstrating high capacity. (5) Back in the park, the boy with glasses walks confidently with the backpack on. He buckles the chest strap and strikes a proud pose with his hand under his chin. The video concludes with a product shot of the backpack against a light, graphic background.

(2) A second child's voice enters with a clear, comforting tone. The BGM remains steady with a strong electronic beat. (3) The narration shifts to a high-pitched, excited delivery style to introduce the product. Sharp 'pop' and 'ding' sound effects punctuate the graphic transitions and text mentions. (4) Distinct Foley sounds are captured, including a liquid splashing effect and the crisp rustling of paper as the backpack's contents are shown. The narrator maintains a fast speech rate with enthusiastic rising intonations. (5) The narration concludes with an authoritative yet joyful tone. A final 'whoosh' transition leads into the fading BGM and eventual silence.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Problem -> Solution -> Feature Showcase -> Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional advertisement for 'PuGo' school backpacks. It utilizes a dramatic emotional opening where a child falls to highlight the need for a protective and ergonomic bag. It then transitions into an informative feature showcase, detailing the backpack's modularity, waterproof material, capacity, and safety strips, aiming to persuade parents of its utility and durability.
